improvements: Refreshed both complete source canopy contours, source pitch and north video-board footprint; roof tops follow the tagged 36 m round profile.
Lowered inherited 38 m deck blocks so they no longer bury the 26–36 m source canopy; lettering follows the curved roof at approximately the published 93 m / 40 m lengths.
The pitch remains free of invisible solid collision, while solid bowl decks retain height-banded colliders.
remainingGaps: Source conflict: current OSM roof:colour=white is rendered; the independently viewed Esri aerial shows navy canopies. The imagery acquisition date is unconfirmed.
The rounded seating bowl, exposed seating rows, 66 m arch rise, detailed cable suspension and some deck elevations remain estimates.
The official MKA source establishes the 720 ft / 219.5 m tied-arch span, not a surveyed complete roof/arch section.
These are isolated front/top/oblique model studies, not matched street-eye Street View/aerial comparisons. They do not establish full-world, night, weather or seasonal parity.

The shared explicit-ID source-replacement implementation is integrated in production (2c73f3d986a4e52d85f5520ca6cb3d4b732f0d13). These studies retain their actual capture-era source and do not establish current district placement, road/body clearance, traffic/mirror budgets or seasonal parity. Registry entries outside a district list and context-only models with no replacement IDs do not replace neighbouring buildings.
